sources.topic: Dismount, supplied DOS information, format, mount, garbage-only purge, volume queries and total-only memory outputs
Device lifecycle signatures, 11-character label truncation and RD/FR versus FROM/DRAM/CMOS query outputs

implementation.backend: Explicit DeviceFiles MemoryFiles subclass with configured virtual volumes; management refuses DirectoryFiles, plain MemoryFiles and absent backends
implementation.lifecycle: Synchronous idempotent mount state, open-file guards for dismount/format/purge, per-volume format and atomic RD/FR combined purge via MF
implementation.accounting: Live bytes plus retained obsolete bytes; FR retains overwritten/deleted bytes by default, other volumes release them unless configured otherwise; purge preserves all live files
implementation.integration: Ordinary FILE, copy/delete/rename/list, XML and batch moves use same mount/quota namespace; complete batch destination growth preflight precedes MOVE_FILE mutations
implementation.persistence: Detached device_files JSON contains all volumes, contents, labels, state flags, obsolete counters and metadata; live handles omitted; conflicts with ordinary files key

portable_choices.bounds: 1..32 volumes; individual and combined capacities <=64 MiB, 32767 files, inherited 1..64 MiB per-file limit
portable_choices.paths: Uppercase device IDs, case-sensitive relative POSIX paths; no OS paths, traversal, backslashes or host discovery; MF reserved for combined purge
portable_choices.format: Only selected virtual media cleared; label truncated to 11 printable ASCII characters; both nowait values complete synchronously; preflight budget/busy failures leave files unchanged
portable_choices.queries: RD/FR labels empty; FROM/DRAM/CMOS total only, preserving other outputs; DOS metadata supplied as named ASCII text fields
portable_choices.status: 0 success, 1 information absent, 2 invalid/unknown, 3 unmounted, 4 busy, 5 read-only, 7 small information output; documented no-garbage warning 85023; VOL_SPACE and ordinary FILE access/quota failures raise before outputs/mutations
